The team walked through the current state of the integration work, agreed on the sequencing for the next two weeks, and settled an open question about where configuration should live. Follow-ups were assigned before the call ended.

## Summary

### Integration status review

Alex walked through what is currently wired up and what remains stubbed. The group agreed the remaining stubs are safe to leave until the migration note is circulated, since nothing downstream reads them yet.

### Configuration ownership

Sam raised that configuration is currently split between two places, which has caused drift twice. The team agreed to consolidate on a single source and to treat the second location as read-only until it can be removed.

### Sequencing for the next two weeks

The group settled on doing the migration note first, the config cutover second, and leaving the runbook update to follow both so it documents the end state rather than an intermediate one.
